subject: Discovery recap: contingency checklist for model diffs and rollback plan
body:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmetech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap: contingency checklist for model diffs and rollback plan

Samir / Alicia —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Short recap + concrete next steps so we stay aligned: we heard that your primary concerns are:
- Invoice extraction hallucinations when we recently moved to model v3.2 (examples in your ticket).
- Need for predictable behavior for month-end billing and supplier statements.
- Compliance: your audit team wants an evidence trail for any rollback or pinning decision.

What we can deliver quickly:
1) Evaluation pack: quick precision/recall snapshot on your invoice prompt set + diff between v3.1 (baseline) and v3.2 (current). See attached "acme_eval_summary_v2.pdf" and "diff_snapshot_20261201.json".
2) Short-term mitigation: 48–72 hour pin to v3.1 for production traffic while we validate v3.2 against your prompt set.
3) Longer-term: run a nightly regression check against your canonical prompt-set, add automated alerts for >3% regression on invoice fields, and propose a canary rollout with traffic-split.

Immediate asks for you:
- Can you confirm we have permission to apply a 48-hour pin to v3.1 if we see >2% drop in extracted invoice accuracy vs baseline? (That gives us breathing room to triage.)
- Please upload three representative problem examples to the HubSpot ticket or the drive link so Karthik can include them in the focused eval.

Attachments: [Attachment: acme_eval_summary_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)], [Attachment: prompt_set_invoices_v1.csv (CSV, 22KB)], [Attachment: diff_snapshot_20261201.json (JSON, 120KB)]

Thanks — I’ll loop in Karthik with the technical checklist.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

------------------------------------------------------------

From: Samir Patel <samir@acmetech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <agomez@acmetech.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: contingency checklist for model diffs and rollback plan

Kimberly —

Appreciate the quick write-up. A few clarifications:
- The hallucinations are producing incorrect vendor totals on ~1.8% of invoices since Friday. For month-end (EOM) we can’t tolerate more than 0.5% deviation.
- We absolutely want the 48-hour pin option. Who signs off on that internally? We’d like the pin applied before EOM close if possible.
- I uploaded three redacted invoices to the Drive link you shared.

Also, we need an audit record: can you provide the exact steps you’ll take when applying/removing the pin and the log artifacts we can retain for our compliance team?

Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Data Ops, AcmeTech
samir@acmetech.com

------------------------------------------------------------

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmetech.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: contingency checklist for model diffs and rollback plan

Samir —

Thanks for the context and the samples. Quick technical summary and the playbook we recommend:

What we saw in the focused eval (details in attached PDF):
- v3.2 improved nominal extraction F1 on our widebench (+2.1%), but on your invoice prompt set it shows a -2.6% delta for vendor_total (driven by subtle tokenization and numeric rounding behavior).
- The diff snapshot includes example prompt/response pairs highlighting where v3.2 splits values across tokens and applies a rounding heuristic.

Recommended immediate actions (order matters):
1) Authorize a short pin to v3.1 for production ingress (48 hours). Implementation: update routing policy to pin AcmeTech routes to model v3.1 and enable prefix KV cache warm-up for the pinned model. We do this on the control plane and emit a pin event.
   - Audit artifacts produced: pin_event_id, routing-change-id, timestamped config snapshot, model-serving logs (per-request model_version field), and request/response digests. We will provide a zip of those artifacts for your audit.
2) Start a focused regression harness: run v3.1 vs v3.2 on full prompt_set_invoices_v1.csv overnight and produce a field-level diff report. We already ran a quick pass (attached).
3) If regressions persist after prompt engineering tweaks, we suggest a staged rollback for non-canonical routes or a canary with 10% traffic to v3.1 while we fix the model variant.

Operational notes:
- Pinning is reversible and we log both the pin and unpin actions; we can generate a signed artifact for compliance if you need an immutable record.
- For insurance, we can schedule an SLA exception that allows immediate rollback without standard 48-hour change freeze (requires deal-level approval).

Next steps for us: I’ll run the full overnight regression and push the artifacts to the Drive link and to HubSpot. Kimberly — if you confirm permission for the 48-hour pin, I can schedule the pin for midnight PST tonight (before EOM batch).

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: [Attachment: acme_eval_summary_v2.pdf], [Attachment: prompt_set_invoices_v1.csv], [Attachment: diff_snapshot_20261201.json]

------------------------------------------------------------

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmetech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: contingency checklist for model diffs and rollback plan

Samir —

Thanks — confirmed. AcmeTech authorized the 48-hour pin as of my note below. Karthik will execute at 23:59 PST tonight unless we hear otherwise.

A few logistics:
- I’m attaching a brief mutual action plan (link) for signatures so we can capture approval for the pin + any SLA exception. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACM-6792
- If we pin, we will: emit pin_event_id, copy the config snapshot to your audit Drive folder, and create a signed archive of the model-serving logs for the pinned window. Karthik will share the archive link when ready.
- We’ll follow up with a post-pin report (field-level diffs, prompts retried, and recommended prompt adjustments).

Proposed timeline:
- Tonight 23:59 PST: apply temporary pin to v3.1 (48 hours).
- Fri morning: Karthik runs full regression and uploads artifacts.
- Fri EOD: review findings and decide on unpin vs staged rollback.

If that works for you, I’ll send the DocuSign for the mutual action plan and mark the HubSpot deal with the committed action.

Best,
—Kimberly

[Mutual action plan draft link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c4d_quickmutualaction]
